description: NetBeans project configuration files (nbproject/) for the compiler project

nodes.name: build-impl.xml
nodes.summary: NetBeans-generated Ant build script (1771 lines) with targets for initialization, compilation, jar packaging, execution, debugging, javadoc generation, test compilation/execution/debugging, applet support, and cleanup. Auto-generated from project.xml; references project.properties for configurable build properties. Part of the NetBeans J2SE project template.

nodes.name: genfiles.properties
nodes.summary: NetBeans IDE tracking file (8 lines) storing CRC32 checksums of build-impl.xml data, script, and stylesheet. Used by the IDE to detect when generated files need regeneration from templates.

nodes.name: project.properties
nodes.summary: NetBeans project build properties (107 lines) defining the compiler's build configuration: Java 21 source/target, main class (sjc.ui.SCG), source/test directories (src, test), classpath dependencies (asm-9.7.jar, asm-tree-9.7.jar, json-20200518.jar), dist/jar settings, JUnit 4 test framework, encoding (UTF-8), and JNLP deployment options.

nodes.name: project.xml
nodes.summary: NetBeans J2SE project descriptor (16 lines) identifying the project type (org.netbeans.modules.java.j2seproject), project name 'compiler', and configuring source-roots (src.dir) and test-roots (test.src.dir). The primary project configuration file from which build-impl.xml is auto-generated.

edges.label: build-impl.xml is generated from project.xml (noted in file header)
